schema.title: TestAlertNodeRequest
schema.description:
Request body for POST /api/settings/notifications/test-alert-node.

All fields optional — when present, they override the persisted Alert
Node designation for this test only, so the Notifications tab can test
the picker's current (possibly unsaved) selection instead of requiring
Save first. Omit them (or omit the whole body) to test the saved
designation.
